title: Mental health mediates the association between cardiorespiratory fitness and academic performance in European schoolchildren.
authors: Muntaner-Mas A, Valenzuela PL, Pinto-Escalona T, Erickson KI, Martínez-de-Quel Ó.
figures: Mental health mediation model of the relationship between cardiorespiratory fitness with grade point average. IE (95 %CI), Indirect Effect (95 % Confidence Interval): %Med, percentage mediated by the proposed mediator
tables: Linear regression analyses between cardiorespiratory fitness, mental health and academic performance in children.

Total, direct, and indirect effects of the mediation analyses investigating mental health as a mediator between cardiorespiratory fitness and academic performance, controlling for sex and socioeconomic level.
